title: chore(devx): launch entries for the scheduled-work and react-pages-off showcase boots
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiNjyvCdXYygFqntMNR7S2dW)_

Fixes #29819

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么:`.claude/launch.json` 新增两条可直接启动的 showcase 配置(3778 开启定时任务、3779 关闭 React 页面),两个 Studio 检查项改为点名这两条配置。
- 为什么改:QA 只能从 launch.json 起服务,原来没有这两种启动方式,`flow-status-matches-runtime` 的定时腿和 `custom-page-source-tiers` 的关闭态每次都只能记 partial / blocked。
- 风险与回滚:只加配置和检查清单文字,不动任何发布包和运行时代码;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.claude/launch.json`(两条新配置的 env 写法),`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` 的 flow-status-matches-runtime(定时腿改在新配置的独立库上重建流程)。
- 两分钟验证:`jq -r '.configurations[].name' .claude/launch.json`,预期三行:showcase-dogfood-3777、showcase-scheduled-work-3778、showcase-react-pages-off-3779。
- 需要你做的:无,`.claude/**` 属 Tier S,席位凭当前 head 的 Contract review PASS 落地。

## What changes

- `.claude/launch.json` gains two entries beside `showcase-dogfood-3777`. Each has its own port and its own `file:/tmp/...` DB, and exports `OS_PORT` as RUNNER.md asks for any non-3000 boot:
  - `showcase-scheduled-work-3778` exports `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1`. DB: `file:/tmp/showcase-scheduled-work-3778/data.db`.
  - `showcase-react-pages-off-3779` exports `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=false`. DB: `file:/tmp/showcase-react-pages-off-3779/data.db`.
- How the env is set: the launch format this repo uses has no `env` key anywhere. Both committed launch files use only `name`, `runtimeExecutable`, `runtimeArgs`, `port` and `url`. The repo already sets env from an entry through its runtime command: `ui/.claude/launch.json` `console-build-test` runs `bash -lc "... VITE_SERVER_URL= DEV_PROXY_TARGET=... exec pnpm dev ..."`. The new entries do the same thing with `runtimeExecutable: "env"`, so no shell string is needed and the argument list stays readable.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`:
  - `studio-authoring.flow-status-matches-runtime` (rev 4 to 5). `fixtures.requires[2]` and `steps[4]` name `showcase-scheduled-work-3778` as the schedule leg's second boot. That entry has its own DB, so the step authors the writable package's schedule flow again there and runs it beside the default boot. `steps[5]` now says it stays on the default boot. `acceptance[3].clause` now reads "a schedule flow authored the same way" (the flow is re-authored on that entry's own DB). A history row was added.
  - `studio-authoring.custom-page-source-tiers` (rev 5 to 6). `fixtures.requires[1]` and `steps[6]` name `showcase-react-pages-off-3779` as the off-state boot of the both-sides gate. The blocked(environment) fallback now applies only if that entry cannot boot. No clause changed. A history row was added.
- The card's third gap, `studio-authoring.picklist-bound-select`, is already met and is not touched here. PR #30128 (merged as 55337f4ce3) re-pointed its `fixtures.requires[0]` to a picklist and a picklistExtensions entry added in a scratch copy of the showcase, never the shared tree (item rev 5). So that item no longer needs a seed change to `examples/app-showcase/objectstack.config.ts`, and this PR changes nothing under `examples/app-showcase/**`.

## Tests

No code changed, so there is no unit test. The evidence is the boot probe and the gates below.

## Acceptance notes

- `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=false` does override the showcase's committed `.env` value `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=true`. `os dev` loads `.env*` through `dotenvFlow.config` (`packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts:432`). dotenv-flow 4.1.0 sets a file variable only when `!process.env.hasOwnProperty(varname)` (`node_modules/.pnpm/dotenv-flow@4.1.0/.../lib/dotenv-flow.js:193`). The CLI notes the same precedence at `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts:448` and `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts:906`. The serve path reads the variable at `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts:930-942` (`readReactPagesTier`; `false` is in `REACT_PAGES_OFF`).
- `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1` is an accepted ON value: `resolveScheduledWorkEnabled()` accepts `1`, `true`, `on` and `yes` (`packages/types/src/env.ts:237-240`).
- The new entries carry `--no-compile` and `--no-watch` (contract review 6637078272, S1): the schedule leg boots beside the default boot of the same checkout, and a compiling boot would rewrite the shared `dist/objectstack.json` the live boot's artifact watcher re-ingests. `--no-compile` still compiles when the artifact is missing (`packages/cli/src/utils/dev-compile-at-boot.ts`). `showcase-dogfood-3777` boots alone and is unchanged.

## Verification

<details><summary>Boot probe (head 71ec4ccb5d, built closure of the showcase plus the CLI)</summary>

- `showcase-scheduled-work-3778`, booted with the exact entry args: health 200. The banner printed `32 flow(s) 21 bound`. With an authenticated `GET /api/v1/automation/_status`, `showcase_scheduled_digest` answered `bound: true` (triggerType schedule) and `showcase_task_due_reminder` answered `bound: true` (time_relative).
- `showcase-react-pages-off-3779`, booted with the exact entry args as the control leg (no scheduled-work switch): health 200, and the banner printed `32 flow(s) 19 bound`, the default-boot count RUNNER.md records.
- The react-pages-off rendering itself is NOT MEASURED in the browser. This container has no `packages/console/dist`, and the boot logged `ConsoleNotBuilt`. The env precedence above was measured directly instead. With `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=false` exported, `dotenvFlow.config` in `examples/app-showcase` kept `false`. With it unset, it loaded `true` from `.env`.
- Both servers were stopped by process group, and their `/tmp` DB directories were removed.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates (dispatch-gates --commands at 71ec4ccb5d, 19 derived)</summary>

All 19 derived commands exited 0. Seven of them first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) before `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, and `check:doc-formula-expressions` also needed its formula and lint build. Each was re-run after that, and those re-runs exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 19 derived, 19 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero). `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: OK, 16 areas and 360 items.
</details>
